summary: Full backend + frontend end-to-end verification of CirebonKarir.com. Wrote 28 pytest cases covering auth (3 roles), meta, public job listing/filter/detail, RBAC (403 on cross-role access), pending-job invisibility, candidate apply flow with real PDF upload, duplicate application block, company job creation + admin approval visibility, admin approve/reject job, company/candidate/category CRUD, block-candidate-then-login-403, and CV download auth (401 anon / 200 owner). All 28 passed. Frontend Playwright tests covered: homepage hero + latest jobs + categories chips, hero search -> /jobs with filtered results, job detail with apply/whatsapp/share buttons, Lamar redirect-to-login-then-back-to-apply, candidate login + dashboard, RBAC redirect (candidate hitting /admin redirected to /candidate/dashboard), admin login + all admin sub-pages (jobs, companies, candidates, categories), company login + applicants + new-job form, 404 page, and mobile viewport hamburger. Everything works.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/.env sets CORS_ORIGINS="*" and CORSMiddleware is initialized with allow_credentials=True. Per browser spec, wildcard origin cannot be combined with credentials; real browsers will silently drop the httpOnly cookie on cross-origin requests. Currently only Bearer-token-in-localStorage keeps the app working. Recommend restricting CORS_ORIGINS to explicit frontend URL(s).
server.py is ~1000 lines and contains routers + models + seed data + storage helpers. Split into modules (auth, jobs, company, admin, seed) for maintainability.

Login brute-force lockout uses (ip:email) key and increments count on every failure including the 6th, 7th... it never resets the locked_until window until a successful login. Consider resetting count after lock window expires so legitimate users are not perpetually locked if they keep trying.
set_auth_cookie uses samesite=none + secure=true, which is correct for cross-site preview URLs but requires HTTPS everywhere; document this for local dev.
attach_company mutates the passed dict in place then returns it; slightly non-obvious. Minor style issue.
expire_jobs runs on nearly every public endpoint; low volume today but consider a background scheduler if data grows.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/register or /api/jobs/{id}/apply. Spam risk.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed jobs/categories/candidates and clean them up (delete pending/rejected TEST jobs, delete TEST categories, TEST candidate register+block persists but harmless). One approved TEST job was cleaned up manually via admin API after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is pytest-based and requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env exported before running: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://cbn-lowongan.preview.emergentagent.com && pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. All flows already validated on 2026-01. If retesting, avoid running the wrong-password test more than 4x per IP (15-min lockout kicks in at 5).
